characters.name: Kaelen
characters.role: An elderly, battle-tested lighthouse keeper stationed along a hazardous dystopian coast. Weary yet resolute, Kaelen features glowing cyan cybernetic eyes for scanning turbulent neon seas and a complex, weathered mechanical prosthetic arm. He wears a dark, heavy rain slicker with glowing neon-pink seams that double as signal conduits.

scenes.environment: Wide cinematic shot of the brutalist metallic lighthouse towering over a violent, glowing neon-pink and cyan bioluminescent sea during a torrential cyberpunk storm.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic animation background concept art, visual development style. A massive brutalist metallic cyberpunk lighthouse perched on jagged black rocks, overlooking a churning bioluminescent ocean of glowing neon-pink and cyan synth-waves. Torrential dark rain falling, heavy electric purple fog, glowing holographic warning icons floating near high-voltage cables, with towering futuristic cyberpunk city ruins on the dark horizon. Deep midnight blue sky (#0B132B), dramatic high-contrast lighting, vivid neon reflections in rain puddles and wave crests, atmospheric composition.

scenes.environment: Interior view of the lighthouse lantern room where Kaelen operates the ancient cybernetic lens controls alongside floating A.U.R.A.
scenes.visual_prompt: Interior view of a high-tech retro-futuristic lighthouse lantern room, animation visual development style. Kaelen, an elderly lighthouse keeper with glowing cyan cybernetic eyes and a mechanical prosthetic arm, stands at a heavy control console looking out torrential rain-slicked curved glass windows. His weathered rain slicker has glowing neon-pink seams. A sleek floating orb-shaped holographic AI companion (A.U.R.A.) hovers nearby emitting soft neon blue light. Volumetric beam of bright golden-yellow (#FFD700) light cutting through heavy electric purple indoor haze and glass reflections, dark purple shadow palette (#3A0CA3), highly detailed production art.

scenes.environment: Low-angle view from the rocky shoreline looking up at the base of the lighthouse as bioluminescent neon waves crash against the rusted metal structure.
scenes.visual_prompt: Low-angle dramatic environment art, animation concept style. Massive glowing bioluminescent waves of vivid neon-pink (#FF007F) and bright cyan (#00F0FF) crash violent foam against the base of a hulking brutalist steel lighthouse. Heavy dark rain streaks across the frame, thick electric purple fog shrouds the upper levels, entangled high-voltage cables arc with tiny yellow sparks. Moody, immersive atmospheric depth, rich painterly textures, dark navy (#1C2541) and rich purple shadows.

scenes.environment: Silhouetted shot of Kaelen and A.U.R.A. on the lighthouse catwalk looking out toward the distant glowing cyberpunk skyline through the storm.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic wide hero shot, production art style. Kaelen silhouetted on a wet metal catwalk surrounding the lighthouse glass tower, neon-pink slicker seams faintly glowing through dark rain. A.U.R.A. floats next to him as a glowing cyan orb silhouette. In the background across the dark bioluminescent ocean, towering dystopian cyberpunk monoliths and megastructures loom in dense electric purple fog, illuminated by glowing holographic advertisements and faint golden (#FFD700) light trails. Epic atmospheric scale, dramatic lighting, vivid neon reflections.
